# Melbourne Flight Training

> > Melbourne Flight Training offers FAA-approved accelerated pilot certification and flight training programs with a 34-aircraft fleet and Platinum Cirrus Training Center.

Melbourne Flight Training (MFT) is a comprehensive flight school located on Florida's Space Coast, specializing in accelerated pathways to professional pilot certification. The school operates under FAA Part 141 and Part 61 regulations, serves international students, and partners with Purdue University Global for degree programs.

## Key Topics

- Career Aviator Pathway
- FAA Part 141 & Part 61
- Cirrus Aircraft Training
- Certified Flight Instructor (CFI)
- Multi-Engine Instructor
- Platinum Cirrus Training Center
- Accelerated Flight Training
- Professional Pilot Certification
- Aircraft Fleet (34 aircraft)
- Purdue University Partnership
- International Student Programs
- M1 Visa Support
- Garmin Avionics
- Redbird FMX Simulator
- Aircraft Rental & Checkouts

## Core Flight Training Programs

- [Career Aviator Program (CAP)](https://mlbflight.com/cap): 12-month accelerated pathway to professional pilot certification with structured curriculum
- [Accelerated Flight Training](https://mlbflight.com/flight-training-accelerated-flight-training): Accelerated flight training with Part 61 and Part 141 FAA-approved courses
- [Pilot Training](https://mlbflight.com/flight-training-pilot-training): Pilot training with Part 141 and Part 61 FAA certification options
- [Flight Training](https://mlbflight.com/flight-training): Flight training programs with 34-aircraft fleet and Cirrus Training Center

## Specialized Training Programs

- [CFI Academy](https://mlbflight.com/cfi-academy-2): 9-week accelerated Certified Flight Instructor training program
- [Cirrus Aircraft Training](https://mlbflight.com/cirrus): Cirrus Aircraft training with Standardized Instructor Pilots and Perspective Touch+
- [Platinum Cirrus Training Center](https://mlbflight.com/cirrus-training-center): Platinum Cirrus Training Center with advanced avionics and aircraft rental
- [Additional Courses Offered](https://mlbflight.com/flight-training-additional-courses-offered): Aircraft type checkouts, endorsements, and time-building for Cirrus and Cessna

## Educational Partnerships & Support

- [Collegiate Partner - Purdue University Global](https://mlbflight.com/collegiate-partner): Purdue University Global partnership for Bachelor of Science in Professional Flight
- [International Students](https://mlbflight.com/international-students-2): FAA Part 141 flight training for international students with M1 visa support
- [Scholarships](https://mlbflight.com/scholarships): Scholarship programs from WAI, AOPA Foundation, and EAA for aspiring aviators
